utilities.purpose: Investigate one bounded repository question that requires discovering and following evidence paths. Return a right-sized, source-backed briefing. Use direct tools for targeted retrieval of known files, symbols, or strings; never use this utility for external facts.

Conduct a bounded adaptive external investigation and return source-backed findings. Use when answering requires discovering and following evidence paths or comparing sources; use direct tools for targeted retrieval of a known URL or API detail. Never for repository-internal questions.
Give an independent reasoned opinion on a bounded problem and cite the evidence for it. Use when a coordinator wants a second opinion reached without seeing the caller's own conclusion.
